retained_trial_corrections: Initial strict Clippy rejected two collapsible if statements. They were rewritten before the first corpus reader run.
The first geometry launch failed to set CPU affinity because the Windows handle signature was not declared. No project comparison began; the corrected signature pins the process to logical CPU 8.

The initial completed geometry run failed eight shapes because compact Bezier handles may omit zero coordinates. Native SVG evidence corrected both the product reader and the test-only oracle normalization; original failed results remain.

A later reference run stopped at its training-only native-pair guard: an unused handle on a public LineClosed path had no same-stem SVG. No reference outside the training set was read. The native omitted-zero checks now apply only to handles used by Bezier primitives; line geometry was unaffected.
